about_short_description.short_description: BTR.Tech provides robotics, AI-driven software, and automation solutions for pharmaceuticals, auto parts, e-commerce, telecom, and more.

product.name: Autonomous Case-Handling Robots
product.description: Robots designed to handle cases autonomously in warehouse environments to reduce manual labor and improve throughput.

product.name: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs)
product.description: Mobile robots that navigate warehouse spaces autonomously to transport goods and support fulfillment processes.

product.name: Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS)
product.description: Systems that automate the storage and retrieval of goods in warehouses to optimize space and speed up order fulfillment.

product.name: Mission Platform™
product.description: A software platform engineered to maximize flow and throughput in storage and fulfillment operations while minimizing errors.

product.name: Advisory Services
product.description: Consulting services providing strategic guidance for planning and implementing automation projects aligned with business goals.

product.name: Design Services
product.description: Services focused on selecting and designing automation solutions tailored to specific operational requirements and constraints.
